<!--
Read CONTRIBUTING.md first. One problem per pull request. Features need a maintainer's yes in
Discussions before the code. Title in Conventional Commits, such as
"fix(composer): pasted images keep their order".
-->

## Problem

<!-- The bug in a sentence or two: what happens, what should happen, how to reproduce it.
Link the issue or the discussion where a maintainer agreed to the feature. -->

## Change

<!-- How this fixes it. If it touches several crates, why each change is needed. -->

## Verification

<!-- The checks you ran and what you saw. "Tests pass" alone is not enough. Say what you could
not check (an OS, a provider). For UI changes, before and after screenshots; a short recording
for motion or timing. Upload them here, do not commit them. -->

<!-- If an agent did the work, name the agent and model. -->
